margin_comparison: Every finite answer-token margin must be >= its floor; candidate EOS also >= candidate floor. Incomplete/nonfinite evidence rejects. q05 does not substitute for the minimum.
benefit_cost_estimate: Development p95 of complete one-level verification plus preparation, including failed calls
benefit_value_estimate: Known stable prefix blocks * calibrated request-prefill ms/token * declared expected remaining reuse, with units converted to ms
online_unprofitable_route: L0 before any GPU verification; controller/planning costs still measured
profile_levels: Each inherited eligible level is a separate development control; formal runtime chooses one frozen model/family level
selection: Exclude choices with observed development compiled material task-score drops >0.03; among remaining choices maximize the conservative development predicted net prefill benefit. Tie: lower verifier cost, then stricter minimum-margin floors. Freeze exact selected catalog and coefficients before new-heldout generation.
formal_checks: Actual complete-wall throughput, ready TTFT mean/p99, all quality routes, output IDs, publication and source-cluster uncertainty; retain failures
